crossRefs.note: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

people.name: Beer-lahai-roi
people.line: Well where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
translations.bsb: Now Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the Negev.
translations.kjv: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
translations.asv: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi. For he dwelt in the land of the South.
